title: THE WHAT IS NEW CARD NAMES THE ARCADE
why: The card was stamped v23.16 and the stamp may not trail the build by more than 0.15. Its new second line names the 2 player arcade demo builds of 2026-10-11: drop-in play from the title menu, a combined team score, a spawn shield and easier fights for newcomers.
now: The what is new card names the 2 player arcade demo.

edits.anchor: 'THIS IS AN ALPHA. Things will break. When something does, the game writes it into your run report and tells you so; that report is how it gets fixed.',
